info.comment: Flat vector food product: minute almonds. A small navy office tin spilled slightly with six beige almond shapes #C9A36A on a white desk. Corporate office aesthetic, clean geometric lines, no text, no faces, no photorealism, no gradients, no 3D, no neon, centered, crisp edges. Palette: navy #1B3A6B, blue #2F6FED, almond beige, white, gray.
